cohort: Singleton pregnant women with cervical insufficiency, with the intervention (Arabin pessary or McDonald cerclage) applied between 14 and 22 gestational weeks.
finding: Pessary use for cervical insufficiency was statistically more effective than cervical cerclage surgery in preventing preterm births < 34 weeks in singleton pregnancy.
gest_age: Intervention applied between 14 and 22 gestational weeks; primary outcome was preterm delivery defined as < 34 gestational weeks.
